audit.whatIsWrong: All seven chart rows said Volibear, and difficulty was 8.5/10 — against a 63.59% Kayle win rate over 412 games, the packet chart, and the page's own whys.
audit.why: whys[2] and whys[3] describe a coinflip; whys[4] onward say Kayle flips and then out-scales outright. Volibear is a finite-scaling bruiser with a 300-range Q; ranged Kayle out-ranges his entire kit.
audit.corrected: Volibear, Volibear, Skill, Skill, Kayle, Kayle, Kayle. Difficulty 4/10, Volibear carry threat 6/10.

audit.why: Four spikes present and right: Volibear levels 1-3, Kayle 6, Kayle first item, Kayle 2+ items.
audit.corrected: Unchanged; phase whys realigned to them.

audit.whatIsWrong: Thundering Smash was described only as 'his engage' with no cooldown and no mention that it is an auto-attack reset; Sky Splitter was never mentioned at all.
audit.why: Thundering Smash is 12/11.5/11/10.5/10s and resets his auto, so the attack wind-up — not the ability cast — is the cue to step back. Sky Splitter is a flat 16s that shields him if he stands in the blast, which changes the all-in maths.
audit.corrected: Both stated in breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d and report[5].t.

audit.whatIsWrong: Anti-heal was named only in itemization; dosFull[2] was titled 'Anti-heal his W heal' but its body text was unrelated boilerplate about wasting Thundering Smash.
audit.why: Frenzied Maul is a 5-second cooldown that applies on-hit effects and heals him on the second cast — chip damage without Grievous Wounds simply refunds.
audit.corrected: dosFull[2].d and dontsFull[1].d now state the 5s cooldown and the Grievous Wounds requirement.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Volibear must walk into your range.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Thundering Smash's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: A coinflip: his W bite sustain matches your poke. Trade only when Thundering Smash is down — 12s at rank 1 — and never near a wall.

edits.before: Level 6 / 11 / 16 are the actual matchups — everything before is stalling. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Volibear's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Divine Ascent goes ranged and R's invulnerability eats his Q-stun all-in whole — pop it as he commits, then kite him with AoE waves.

edits.before: Nashor's Tooth is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Thundering Smash's cooldown.
edits.after: Nashor's plus E's missing-health on-hits out-chunk his W bite refund — fight from outside his 300 Q range.

edits.before: Two items on: your pattern is at full power. Volibear carry threat 8.5/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Evolved E's percent-HP shred melts his stacked health — his tanky bruiser ceiling is just a bigger bar to burn.

notes: Packet flagged 'Divine Ascent's' and 'Divine Judgment's' as suspect names — both are FALSE POSITIVES, they are just possessive forms of the real Kayle abilities. diff was already 'FAV' while diffRating said 8.5/10 and tone was the red #ff5d6c; the rating is now 4/10 but I left tone alone since it is a colour token I cannot verify the palette mapping for. The late-game text says Volibear's R 'suppresses your turret' — Riot's text says towers near his landing are temporarily disabled, which is the same effect, so I left it.
